description_en: Queries the tags of a resource
kebab_example: aliyun nlb list-tag-resources --resource-type loadbalancer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

loadbalancer: the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
securitypolicy: the security policy
servergroup: the server group
listener: the listener
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

loadbalancer：网络型负载均衡实例。
securitypolicy：安全策略。
servergroup：服务器组。
listener：监听
parameters.name: resource_type

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token used to specify a particular page of results. Valid values:

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or the only query.
Set this parameter to the value of NextToken obtained from the previous query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return in each call. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值为50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: Queries the tags of a resource

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.
If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that determines the start point of the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TagResources.description_en: The details about the resource and its tags, including the resource ID, the resource type, and the keys and values of the tags
TagResources.description_zh: 由资源及其标签组成的集合，包含了资源ID、资源类型和标签键值等信息

items.description_zh: 由资源及其标签组成的集合，包含了资源ID、资源类型和标签键值等信息

AliUid.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account

Category.description_en:
The type of the tag. Valid values:

Custom
System
All
Category.description_zh:
标签类型。取值：

Custom：自定义标签。
System：系统标签。
All：全部标签

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of resource. Valid values:

loadbalancer: an NLB instance
securitypolicy: a security policy
servergroup: a server group
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源类型，取值：

loadbalancer：网络型负载均衡实例。
securitypolicy：安全策略。
servergroup：服务器组

Scope.description_en: The visible range of the tags

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
